name: Report plugin self-check findings to GitHub code scanning
query: I want the plugin self-check findings to show up in GitHub Security alerts on every pull request.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Load references/testing-and-quality.md (local self-check script section)
Step 2: Copy check_plugin_basics.mjs into the plugin repo
Step 3: Add a workflow job that runs it with --format sarif and uploads with github/codeql-action/upload-sarif
Step 4: Grant security-events: write and pass --uri-prefix when the plugin lives in a subfolder
success_criteria: Explains that findings are heuristic and need review
